messages.subject: running local with session$clientData$url_search
parts:
Hi,

I have a shiny app that uses session$clientData$url_search. The url_search usage works fine when I post the app to a server, and run it in chrome using a url like 'http://server.computer.com:3838/app?tst_string'.

But how do I specify the '?tst_string' when I run local using runApp()? When I run local using runApp() with chrome it opens url http://127.0.0.1:7698/. After the app is up and running, I can add '?tst_string' and hit the reload button. But it becomes tedious repetition.

How may I make the app use http://127.0.0.1:7698/?tst_string on the 1st startup?

Jonathan



http://127.0.0.1:7698/
